pilot_status.note: Sourced from the completed April 6, 2026 candidate packet on the official FY2025 to FY2026 pair. P2 is the default public read, P1 is the main comparator, and P0 remains a simple-prompt control kept below the fold.

comparison_pairs.label: Control read vs Primary read

comparison_pairs.label: Primary read vs Comparison read
comparison_pairs.purpose: Same tagged packet; isolates how protocol framing changes the first-read story between P2 and P1.

takeaways: On WMT, moving from P0 to P2 materially improves the distinction between a calm selective sharpening and a claim that the whole risk map was reordered.

Holding the i2 tagged packet fixed while moving from P2 to P1 shows that protocol framing changes how strongly customer-interface risk, AI-amplified cyber threats, and tariff persistence lead the read.
This remains a bounded public case about one official fiscal pair, not a broad claim about retail filings or agentic commerce generally.
caveats: This is a single-company, single-pair case comparison, not a benchmark or screener.
The comparison is strongest on selective sharpenings and refreshed specifics, not on proving a wholesale enterprise reprioritization.
Outline-compare artifacts for this candidate remain manual-review-only and are intentionally not shipped in this pass.
